test_policy.notes: PLU does not require tests; applicants decide whether to have ACT or SAT scores considered. The admission GPA (weighted for AP/IB/Cambridge/Honors, max 4.50) is used for admission and scholarships.

requirements.notes: Apply with the Common App or PLU's international first-year application; the page says it is free to apply. Needs a personal essay of at least 250 words, official English-translated transcripts, and an optional academic recommendation. After admission a bank statement, passport copy and $200 enrollment deposit are needed before the I-20/DS-2019.

deadlines.label: Early Action I (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: The page gives no year, so the fall 2027 cycle is assumed. Decision and scholarship notice by Dec. 1.

deadlines.label: Early Action II (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Decision and scholarship notice by Jan. 1. Also the date to be considered for Presidential Scholarships.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Decision and scholarship notice within a month.

deadlines.label: Final application deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Applications completed after Feb. 1 are reviewed on a rolling basis.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Alternatives to a test: one college English class with B or better (semester system) or two (quarter system); SAT EBRW 500+; ACT English 21+; GCE O-Level English B; a pre-approved non-PLU ESL program (CEFR B2); a secondary diploma from Nordic countries or the Netherlands (English grade 7+) or from a listed English-medium country (e.g. U.S., Canada, UK, Australia, Ireland, Nigeria, South Africa, Philippines); or documentation that all instruction was in English for at least 2 years. No conditional-admission or ESL pathway is described.

english.notes: Page says 'TOEFL: 4.0' without naming the scale and gives no old 0-120 score; 4.0 matches the new 1-6 scale.

aid.notes: International Merit Awards of $8,000-$32,000 per year (first-year and transfer, no application). Stackable: Housing Grant $2,500/yr for living on campus, Visit Scholarship $1,000/yr, Presidential Scholarship (3.8 weighted GPA plus leadership, apply by Dec. 1; variable amount), Artistic Achievement Awards $1,000-$7,500 (audition), Alumni Dependent $1,000; International Access Grant $2,000 for Nordic-country students. PLU says students should expect to pay at least half or more of tuition plus all living costs themselves; no need-based aid for international students is described.

cost.notes: PLU's 2026-2027 international student expense estimate: tuition and fees $55,760; room and meals $14,670; health insurance, books and personal expenses $4,491; total $74,921, which is the amount of the required financial guarantee minus the scholarship in the admission letter

majors.notes: Applying to PLU is also applying to the business school; no separate application.
Not an impacted major; no separate application.
No separate application. If selected, admission to the BSN program starting in the third year is guaranteed after completing academic requirements.
